descriptor: Simple kanban board for small teams

voice.summary: Sounds like a good team lead at a whiteboard: short labels, clear verbs, no fluff. It keeps tasks small and counts them honestly.
dos: Name cards with a verb and an object
Keep tags to one lowercase word

taglines: Plan the sprint, then do it
boilerplate: Tallyboard is a lightweight kanban board for small teams, with drag-and-drop columns, quick card capture and filters that keep a sprint visible.

microcopy.error: Could not move that card, try again
microcopy.empty: Nothing here yet, add a card

logo.note: Stacked layers read as cards sitting in a column.
